title: "Will Stay Alive Till July 20": Sonam Wangchuk Refuses To Call Off Fast
description: The 59-year-old Wangchuk, who is demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the alleged NEET paper leak, has urged people to ensure a massive turnout for the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) proposed march to parliament on July 20.
